name: bob-chat
description: BoB Chat — remote Telegram and WhatsApp control via your phone or Mac over a cloud relay (up to 4 accounts per device). See linked devices and accounts, list chats, read unread/recent with pagination, search contacts and message history, send messages, and mark chats read. Runs on-device.

interface.shortDescription: Remote Telegram and WhatsApp control via your phone
interface.longDescription: Control your Telegram and WhatsApp through the BoB Chat app (Android / iOS / macOS, up to 4 accounts per device) over a cloud relay — see linked devices and what MCP may do, list chats (filter by type: people/bots/groups/channels), read unread/recent with pagination, search contacts and message history, send messages, and mark chats read. Runs entirely on your device; no chat data is stored server-side.
defaultPrompt: Find a contact and send them a message, or summarize my unread chats
